pop
shift
pop-element
shift-element
take 0
take 2
take 4
take 9
take x
take

# one element
as one arr 0.:int=5
pop @one
shift @one
take @one 1

# the empty list
as none arr
pop @none
shift @none
pop-element @none
shift-element @none
take @none 0
take @none 3

# not a list
as m obj k 0.:int=1
pop @m
shift @m
pop-element @m
shift-element @m
take @m 1
as s str text
pop @s
